scope: A pass supports finite prepared-clock synchronization and relative-phase storage. The D/X observer is passive. This is not a local physical comparator, detector, unconditional presence latch, capture, approval or release mechanism; no photon or Born-rule claim follows. Different input phases remain recoverable in the full reversible board.
